In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

Al-Hasan said: their water is gone. Al-Kalbi said: they are set on fire.

﴿And when the graves are overturned﴾: they are searched, scattered and stirred up, so that what is in the earth of treasures is extracted, and those in them of the dead are brought to life. It is said: "ba'thara al-hawd" and "bahtharahu," when one demolishes it and makes its bottom its top. This is one of the signs of the Hour: that the earth will bring forth the best of its entrails, of its gold, its silver and its wealth. ﴿A soul will know what it has sent forward﴾ of righteous or wicked deeds, ﴿and what it has left behind﴾ of a good or evil sunnah. ʿIkrimah said: what it has sent forward of the obligations it fulfilled, and what it has left behind of the obligations it neglected. O you who conceal sin, are you not ashamed before Allah, when you are His companion in privacy?
